item.title: Program helps North Little Rock School District students earn associate's degree
item.description: Through a partnership with the University of Arkansas-Pulaski Technical College, high school students in the North Little Rock School District now have the opportunity to earn their high school diploma and an associate's degree at the same time when they graduate.

item.title: AST Blog: Year of Last Tornado in Each Arkansas County (1950-2025)
item.description: A map that shows the most recent confirmed tornado in each Arkansas county from 1950 through 2025, with darker colors indicating more recent tornadoes and lighter colors indicating longer periods without one.

item.title: North Little Rock land sale clears way for free parking
item.description: North Little Rock City Council voted this week to approve the sale of the Arkansas Technical School's property that will now be turned into a parking lot which is set to be free for at least the next two years.

item.title: Arkansan unearths 6.03-carat diamond during livestream from Crater of Diamonds State Park
item.description: Two friends mining at Arkansas' Crater of Diamonds State Park during a livestream found a 6.03-carat yellow diamond, which is the fourth-largest yellow diamond and 22nd-largest diamond of any color registered since the park's establishment in 1972.
